Mike, saw SearchStax shipped its new recovery model for enterprise search and took G2 Site Search category leadership again.

Momentum like that usually means more accounts researching you than the team can actually work, and that is where pipeline leaks before reps even see it. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SearchStax needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
